content:
Here are simple templates you can copy/paste to acknowledge an email, depending on the situation:

### 1) Quick acknowledgement (neutral)
Subject: Re: [Original Subject]  
Hi [Name],  
Thanks for your email—received. I’ll review and get back to you by [day/time].  
Best,  
[Your Name]

### 2) Acknowledge + confirm you’ll act
Hi [Name],  
Thanks for the update. I’ve received this and will [next step]. I’ll follow up by [date].  
Regards,  
[Your Name]

### 3) Acknowledge + you need more time
Hi [Name],  
Thanks—received. I’m looking into it and will reply with an update by [date/time].  
Best,  
[Your Name]

### 4) Acknowledge + answer is coming later (busy)
Hi [Name],  
Thank you for your message. I’m tied up at the moment, but I’ve noted this and will respond in full by [date].  
Kind regards,  
[Your Name]

### 5) Acknowledge + confirm meeting/appointment
Hi [Name],  
Confirmed—thank you. I’ve got this scheduled for [day/date] at [time].  
Best,  
[Your Name]

### 6) Very short (internal/fast)
Received, thanks. I’ll follow up by [date/time].  
—[Your Name]

If you tell me the context (work/school/customer support), the tone you want (formal or casual), and what you’re acknowledging, I can tailor a perfect reply.
